findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_fetch, verify_compliance-scan, psych_page-audit · Private data: psych_trust-signals, psych_enforcement, web_fetch, legal_ai-disclosure, legal_claims, legal_subscriptions, legal_messaging, legal_scraping · Public sink: web_fetch, legal_ai-disclosure, legal_messaging.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_fetch, verify_compliance-scan, psych_page-audit · Private data: psych_trust-signals, psych_enforcement, web_fetch, legal_ai-disclosure, legal_claims, legal_subscriptions, legal_messaging, legal_scraping · Public sink: web_fetch, legal_ai-disclosure, legal_messaging

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
